body:
ARCANE SPIDER CR 4

XP 1,200
N Medium vermin
Init +3, Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +6 natural)
hp 45 (7d8 +14)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +3

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Melee bite +8 (2d6+3 plus poison plus draining bite)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 16, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 11, Cha 9
Base Atk +5; CMB +7, CMD 20

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Poison (Ex)

Bite-injury; save Fort DC 18; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d6 Str and 1d6 Con; cure 1 save.

Permanent Invisibility (Su)

The arcane spider is invisible at all mes. To locate it in combat, a creature must make a Perception check opposed by its Stealth. Even if this succeeds, attacking creatures are at disadvantage due to being unable to see it. Its attacks are at advantage as long as the target cannot see it.

Draining Bite (Su)

A creature bi en by the arcane spider loses its highest level available spell slot when bi en. This recovers after a long rest as normal.
